title: Gordon Gray named in the MJ12 documents

tellings.quote: Gray was also named as one of the advisers on the top secret research and development organization established by Truman as it appears in the leaked Majestic [music] 12 documentation.

plain: An official named Gordon Gray appears in the Majestic 12 papers, leaked documents that describe a top-secret research group President Truman is said to have set up around 1947 to deal with UFOs. The papers list Gray as one of the group's advisers. Michels points this out himself while asking whether a secret program to recover crashed craft existed, and whether Henry Kissinger oversaw it.
